title: Shane Freaks shown a sphere
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Shane Freaks shown a sphere, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: This guy Shane Freaks old vet symposium on Twitter and he talks about being shown a sphere.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels mentions a man named Shane Freaks, an old military veteran who posts on Twitter. According to Michels, Freaks says he was once shown a sphere, apparently some kind of unexplained object. If true, it would add one more person claiming to have seen such hidden objects up close.
